description: Mutate the issue tracker. v1 implements op=close and can implement op=transition and op=comment when the configured writer supports those capabilities. Unsupported ops such as op=link_pr return tool_failed{error.category=unsupported_op}.
name: tracker_write

op.description: Discriminator. v1 implements 'close' and optionally 'transition' or 'comment' when the configured writer supports those capabilities; unsupported ops return tool_failed{error.category=unsupported_op}.

toState.description: Target issue state for op=transition. If the configured writer does not support transitions, op=transition returns unsupported_op regardless of this value.
